items.meaning: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol，提供一种使用 TCP/IP 协议栈向主机传送配置参数的机制
BOOTP，其报文格式是 DHCP 报文格式的基础，使 DHCP 与 BOOTP 参与方在特定情况下可交换报文
DHCP 消息类型选项（编号 51），DHCP 服务器收到的包含该选项的报文被认为是 DHCP 客户端所发送
BOOTP 客户端，其报文不带 DHCP Message Type 选项，因而被假定为 BOOTP 客户端所发送
DHCP 服务器，其对 BOOTP 客户端的支持是可选的，由本地系统管理员决定
items.constraint: Support of BOOTP clients by a DHCP server is optional at the discretion of the local system administrator

items.meaning: 未配置支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器在收到 BOOTP 客户端的 BOOTREQUEST 时静默丢弃该报文

items.object: the BOOTREQUEST message
items.condition: a DHCP server that is not configured to support BOOTP clients receives a BOOTREQUEST message from a BOOTP client

items.meaning: 配置为支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器可被配置为提供静态地址、自动地址或两者
items.constraint: a DHCP server configured to support BOOTP clients may be configured to supply static addresses, automatic addresses or both
items.object: static addresses, automatic addresses or both
items.condition: a DHCP server is configured to support BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 静态地址，即先前由系统管理员分配并存储于 DHCP 服务器可用数据库中的地址
自动地址，即由 DHCP 服务器从其未分配地址池中选取的地址
允许 DHCP 服务器返回自动地址的决定必须处于系统管理员的控制之下
items.constraint: the decision to allow a DHCP server to return automatic addresses must be under the control of the system administrator
items.action: be under the control of the system administrator
items.object: the decision to allow a DHCP server to return automatic addresses

items.meaning: 若 DHCP 服务器支持向 BOOTP 客户端提供自动地址，该特性必须是可配置的
items.constraint: this feature must be configurable

items.condition: a DHCP server supports supplying automatic addresses to BOOTP clients

items.object: the feature of supplying automatic addresses to BOOTP clients
items.condition: a DHCP server supports supplying automatic addresses to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 启用该特性必须是系统管理员主动决定的结果
items.constraint: Enabling of the feature must be the result of an active decision by the system administrator

items.object: enabling of the feature

items.meaning: DHCP 服务器必须为分配给 BOOTP 客户端的自动地址指定无限租期

items.object: an infinite lease duration for automatic addresses assigned to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 分配给 BOOTP 客户端的这类网络地址不能被服务器自动重新分配
items.constraint: Such network addresses cannot be automatically reassigned by the server
items.object: such network addresses

items.meaning: 本地系统管理员可选择手动释放分配给 BOOTP 客户端的网络地址
items.constraint: The local system administrator may choose to manually release network addresses assigned to BOOTP clients
items.object: network addresses assigned to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器
items.constraint: MUST interact with BOOTP clients according to the BOOTP protocol
items.action: interact with BOOTP clients according to the BOOTP protocol
items.object: BOOTP clients
items.condition: A DHCP server that supports BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 发送 BOOTREPLY 报文的服务端
items.constraint: MUST formulate a BOOTP BOOTREPLY message rather than a DHCP DHCPOFFER message
items.object: a BOOTP BOOTREPLY message rather than a DHCP DHCPOFFER message

items.meaning: 发送 BOOTREPLY 报文的服务端
items.constraint: MUST NOT include the 'DHCP message type' option
items.object: 'DHCP message type' option

items.meaning: BOOTP 应答报文
items.constraint: MUST NOT exceed the size limit for BOOTREPLY messages
items.object: the size limit for BOOTREPLY messages

items.meaning: 发送 BOOTREPLY 后把 BOOTP 客户端绑定标记为 BOUND 的服务端
向 BOOTP 客户端发送 DHCP 选项的 DHCP 服务器
items.constraint: MAY send any DHCP Options to a BOOTP client as allowed by the RFC [2]
items.object: BOOTP client
items.condition: as allowed by the "DHCP Options and BOOTP Vendor Extensions" RFC [2]

items.meaning: 可被返回自动地址的 BOOTP 客户端
items.constraint: May return automatic addresses to BOOTP clients
items.object: BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 控制是否向 BOOTP 客户端返回自动地址的配置开关

items.object: a configuration switch
items.condition: if returning automatic addresses to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 该可选配置项（是否向 BOOTP 客户端返回自动地址）
items.constraint: MUST default this optional configuration to OFF
items.object: this optional configuration to OFF

items.meaning: BOOTP 规范，是与 BOOTP 客户端交互时必须遵守的规范文档
items.constraint: MUST abide by the BOOTP specification when interacting with BOOTP clients
items.object: the BOOTP specification
items.condition: when interacting with BOOTP clients

items.meaning: DHCP 选项，即 DHCP options 文档定义而 BOOTP vendor extensions 文档未定义的选项
items.constraint: MAY send DHCP options to a BOOTP client
items.object: DHCP options to a BOOTP client

items.object: a reply from a DHCP server in preference to a reply from a BOOTP server

items.meaning: 原始 BOOTP 规范，其中遗留了一些未明确的问题
BOOTP 协议，本文档的信息与要求也适用于其扩展如 DHCP
REQUIRED 表示该项是规范的绝对要求。
RECOMMENDED 表示在特定情况下可能有正当理由忽略该项，但选择不同做法前应理解全部影响并仔细权衡。
OPTIONAL 表示该项确实是可选的；一个厂商可以包含它，另一个厂商可以省略它。
BOOTP 实体在若干情况下应静默丢弃收到的 BOOTP 报文，即不进一步处理该报文。
items.object: received BOOTP message
items.condition: several cases

items.meaning: 静默丢弃报文时，实体不得因此发送任何 ICMP 错误消息。

items.entity: IP Total Length and UDP Length

items.object: either the code for a BOOTREQUEST (1) or the code for a BOOTREPLY (2)

由于采用非透明桥接，必须对 client/server 与 client/relay agent 的交互在 IEEE 802.5 网络上给予特别考虑。

items.object: its broadcast BOOTREQUEST with an All Routes Explorer RIF

items.object: to the client's hardware address, as taken from the BOOTP message, with a Spanning Tree Rooted RIF

属于该类别的客户端应把其生成的 BOOTREPLY 消息 'flags' 字段中新定义的 BROADCAST 标志置为 1，以提示 BOOTP 服务器和中继代理尝试广播 BOOTREPLY。

items.condition: If a client does not have this limitation (i.e., it is perfectly able to receive unicast BOOTREPLY messages)

items.object: so that they may receive unicast BOOTREPLY messages

items.meaning: 上述 BROADCAST 标志变通机制

items.meaning: BOOTP 客户端

items.meaning: BOOTREQUEST 消息中的 secs 字段

items.meaning: BOOTREQUEST 消息中的 secs 字段

items.constraint: the relay agent SHOULD choose one IP address associated with that interface and use it consistently for all BOOTP messages it relays

items.condition: If the interface has more than one IP address logically associated with it

items.object: 'giaddr' field
items.condition: If the 'giaddr' field contains some non-zero value

items.meaning: 转发目的地配置，应独立于其他所谓“broadcast forwarders”的目的地配置

items.entity: configurable list of destination IP addresses
items.meaning: 可配置的目的地 IP 地址列表提供了良好的灵活性

items.condition: for all BOOTREQUEST messages it relays from a given client

items.constraint: all BOOTREQUEST messages from a given client MUST be relayed to the same destination (or set of destinations)
items.object: the same destination (or set of destinations)
items.condition: from a given client

如果 BOOTREQUEST 带有非零 UDP 校验和，则必须重新计算校验和。
items.constraint: the checksum must be recalculated

items.condition: If the BOOTREQUEST has a UDP checksum (i.e., the UDP checksum is non-zero)

items.meaning: BOOTP 中继代理只将 BOOTREPLY 消息中继给 BOOTP 客户端。
items.constraint: relay BOOTREPLY messages only to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器负责将 BOOTREPLY 消息直接发送给在 'giaddr' 字段中标识的中继代理。
items.constraint: send BOOTREPLY messages directly to the relay agent identified in the 'giaddr' field

items.object: that all BOOTREPLY messages it receives are intended for BOOTP clients on its directly-connected networks

items.meaning: 当中继代理收到 BOOTREPLY 消息时，它应检查 BOOTP 的 'giaddr'、'yiaddr'、'chaddr'、'htype' 和 'hlen' 字段。
items.constraint: should examine the BOOTP 'giaddr', 'yiaddr', 'chaddr', 'htype', and 'hlen' fields
items.object: the BOOTP 'giaddr', 'yiaddr', 'chaddr', 'htype', and 'hlen' fields
items.condition: When a relay agent receives a BOOTREPLY message

items.object: adequate information for the relay agent to deliver the BOOTREPLY message to the client

items.condition: If the content of the 'giaddr' field does not match one of the relay agent's directly-connected logical interfaces

items.condition: If the BROADCAST flag is cleared (0)

items.condition: If unicasting is not possible

items.object: the link-layer broadcast address
items.condition: If unicasting is not possible ... in which case

items.constraint: 旧实现应被纠正以符合本规范
items.object: Older client or server implementations which accidentally set the BROADCAST flag

items.meaning: 所有 BOOTP 字段必须被完整保留。
items.constraint: 所有 BOOTP 字段必须完整保留
items.object: All BOOTP fields

items.meaning: 中继代理在向客户端中继时不得修改 BOOTREPLY 报文的任何 BOOTP 字段。
items.constraint: 中继时不得修改 BOOTREPLY 的 BOOTP 字段

items.condition: when relaying it to the client

items.action: have its UDP destination port set to

items.object: the checksum
items.condition: If the BOOTREPLY has a UDP checksum (i.e., the UDP checksum is non-zero)

items.action: accept for local delivery to the server

items.object: any received UDP messages whose UDP destination port number is BOOTPC (68)

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器应当无需处理发往 BOOTPC 端口的报文（说明性陈述）。

items.constraint: 一致性检查SHOULD由BOOTP服务器执行
items.object: the consistency checks specified in Section 2.1

items.meaning: 不满足这些一致性检查的BOOTP消息必须被静默丢弃
items.constraint: 不满足一致性检查的消息MUST被静默丢弃

items.condition: not meeting these consistency checks

items.meaning: BOOTP服务器收到BOOTREQUEST时可把secs字段值作为决定是否回复及如何回复的因素

迄今BOOTP协议的这一特性尚未被证明一定有用

items.constraint: BOOTP服务器SHOULD准备好应对这些不同解释
items.object: these varying interpretations

items.meaning: 一般不应把ciaddr字段单独作为识别客户端的唯一键
items.constraint: ciaddr字段SHOULD NOT被单独信任为识别键
items.object: the 'ciaddr' field as a sole key in identifying a client
items.condition: In general

items.meaning: ciaddr、chaddr、htype、hlen等字段内容应一起考虑来决定如何回复客户端

BOOTP 服务器返回给客户端的应答消息

items.constraint: 服务器应首先检查 'ciaddr' 字段

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器返回给客户端的应答消息

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器端口号 67

items.meaning: BOOTP 中继代理，负责向客户端做最终投递

items.meaning: 新定义的 BROADCAST 标志，用于指示中继代理是否应广播 BOOTREPLY

items.meaning: 负责投递 BOOTREPLY 的 BOOTP 服务器
